heading: INT. ROOFTOP GREENHOUSE - APARTMENT BLOCK - DAWN

units.text: INT. ROOFTOP GREENHOUSE - APARTMENT BLOCK - DAWN
A glass lean-to bolted to a tar roof, crowded with tomato vines and orchid pots.
Gray light.
Condensation drips from the panes.
A fan turns slowly overhead.
DETECTIVE OSWALDO PEREIRA-LANE (50s, rumpled raincoat, thermos) stands over a body slumped between the tomato racks.
The victim wears a gardener's apron and rubber boots.
At the door, patrolwoman SABINA KOWALCZYK (20s, rain cape) guards the entrance.
Next to her stands the building super, MR. THADDEUS BRIGHTWATER (60s, keys on a ring, cardigan), wringing his cap.
On the far side of the glass, a nervous tenant, MISS HYACINTH LOVELACE (30s, silk robe, bare feet), watches from the stairwell.
Who found him?
units.name: OSWALDO

units.text: I did, Detective. Came up to check the pipes.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: What time?
units.name: OSWALDO

units.text: Half past five.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: Oswaldo crouches.
A small trowel lies beside the body, clean.
He lifts the victim's hand.
The fingernails are packed with fresh soil.
The roof door. Locked or unlocked?
units.name: OSWALDO

units.text: Unlocked, sir.
units.name: SABINA

units.text: Who has a key?
units.name: OSWALDO

units.text: Just me. And Miss Lovelace. She waters the orchids.
units.name: THADDEUS

units.text: All eyes shift to the stairwell.
Hyacinth steps back into the shadows, then slowly forward again.
I was asleep.
units.name: HYACINTH

units.text: Miss Lovelace, your feet are muddy.
units.name: OSWALDO

units.text: She looks down.
Pale mud streaks both soles.
Oswaldo pours coffee from the thermos into its cap, sips, and says nothing for a long moment.
